title: wss: Acknowledgements omits RFC 8441
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 lists RFC 8441 (WebSocket over HTTP/2) as an informative reference but the Acknowledgements section only credits Murchison (RFC 8887) and the JMAP working group (RFC 8620). RFC 8441 has separate authors (McManus). Decision: either add an acknowledgement for RFC 8441, or remove RFC 8441 from informative references if it is not substantively used.
close_reason: Removed RFC 8441 from informative references rather than adding an acknowledgement — the WSS draft doesn't use RFC 8441 directly; HTTP/2 WebSocket support is covered by RFC 8887 which already references it.
